title: Their Queen Is on Your Doorstep
setup: Black's queen on f2 rakes the rank beside your king and its rook and bishop are both active — you look completely lost.
hint: Do not look at your own king at all. Ask where Black's king can go after a check on the eighth.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qg8+}} drives the king to h6 and {{Rh7#}} finishes, the queen on g8 holding the rook. Being under attack is only fatal if you are a move slower; here you are a move faster.
